name: Nagytarcsa (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of green over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nagytarcsa (a blue shield with a sun, a crescent and a yellow figure) below the name Nagytarcsa in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
